```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# data wrangling
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)  # for color functions

# data vis
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)
```

# Combined circos: shared taxa across logistic (OR) and CLR (beta) analyses
#
# Ring order (outermost -> innermost):
#   1. Logistic regression odds ratios
#   2. CLR beta coefficients
#   3. Prevalence  (taken ONLY from the OR / logistic df)
#   4. Phylum      (taken ONLY from the OR / logistic df)
#
# Taxa are subset to those appearing in BOTH analyses and aligned to a single
# shared row order (the OR sort by abx_three, decreasing).

## Read logistic (OR) data

```{r read.combined.ORs.qs}
microbe_ORs = read.csv("../data/sig_logit_all_ors_rarefied.csv")
q_values_OR = read.csv("../data/sig_logit_all_qs_rarefied.csv")

rownames(microbe_ORs) = microbe_ORs$plot_name
microbe_ORs$plot_name <- NULL
microbe_ORs$feature   <- NULL

rownames(q_values_OR) = q_values_OR$plot_name
q_values_OR$plot_name <- NULL
q_values_OR$feature   <- NULL
```

## Read CLR (beta) data

```{r read.combined.betas.qs}
microbe_betas = read.csv("../data/microbe_betas_sugar_chol_abx_10percent.csv")
q_values_beta = read.csv("../data/microbe_qs_sugar_chol_abx_10percent.csv")

rownames(microbe_betas) = microbe_betas$plot_name
microbe_betas$plot_name <- NULL
microbe_betas$feature   <- NULL

rownames(q_values_beta) = q_values_beta$plot_name
q_values_beta$plot_name <- NULL
q_values_beta$feature   <- NULL
```

## Sort + rename columns (12-month first, matching the circos convention)

```{r sort.rename.cols}
microbe_ORs_sorted <- microbe_ORs[order(microbe_ORs[, "abx_three"],
                                        decreasing = TRUE), ]
rename_vec <-  c(
  abx_twelve = "3 - 12 mo.",
  abx_three  = "0 - 3 mo."
  )

colnames(microbe_ORs_sorted)  <- recode(colnames(microbe_ORs_sorted),  !!!rename_vec)
colnames(microbe_betas)       <- recode(colnames(microbe_betas),       !!!rename_vec)
colnames(q_values_OR)   <- recode(colnames(q_values_OR),   !!!rename_vec)
colnames(q_values_beta) <- recode(colnames(q_values_beta), !!!rename_vec)
```

## Restrict to shared taxa, aligned to a single row order

```{r shared.taxa}
# Shared taxa = intersection of the two analyses' plot_name row identifiers.
shared_taxa <- intersect(rownames(microbe_ORs_sorted), rownames(microbe_betas))

# Preserve the OR sort order (abx_three, decreasing) for the shared taxa.
shared_taxa <- rownames(microbe_ORs_sorted)[rownames(microbe_ORs_sorted) %in% shared_taxa]

message("Number of shared taxa: ", length(shared_taxa))

# Subset every data frame to the shared taxa, in the SAME order.
microbe_ORs_shared   <- microbe_ORs_sorted[shared_taxa, ]
microbe_betas_shared <- microbe_betas[shared_taxa, ]
q_OR_shared          <- q_values_OR[shared_taxa, ]
q_beta_shared        <- q_values_beta[shared_taxa, ]
```

## Significance annotation logic (unchanged)

```{r set.up.significance}
# Significance annotation logic
stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
  if (p < 0.1)  return("#")
  return("")
}
```

## Build matrices (12-month column first, matching the circos version)

```{r define.color.columns}
OR_cols   <- c("3 - 12 mo.", "0 - 3 mo.")
beta_cols <- c("3 - 12 mo.", "0 - 3 mo.")

### OR matrix + aligned q-values
OR_matrix <- as.matrix(microbe_ORs_shared[, OR_cols])
rownames(OR_matrix) <- shared_taxa
qval_mat_OR <- as.matrix(q_OR_shared) #[, OR_cols]

### CLR beta matrix + aligned q-values
beta_matrix <- as.matrix(microbe_betas_shared[, beta_cols])
rownames(beta_matrix) <- shared_taxa
qval_mat_beta <- as.matrix(q_beta_shared) #[, beta_cols]
```

## Colors + annotations (prevalence + phylum taken from the OR df only)

```{r colors.annotations}
phyla_colors <- c(
  "Actinobacteria"   = "#9400D3",
  "Bacteroidetes"    = "#FF8C00",
  "Cyanobacteria"    = "#00FFE2",
  "Firmicutes"       = "#4682B4",
  "Fusobacteria"     = "#DC143C",
  "Lentisphaerae"    = "#C1AD09",
  "Patescibacteria"  = "#FF69B4",
  "Proteobacteria"   = "#33a02c",
  "Tenericutes"      = "#FFFF00",
  "Verrucomicrobia"  = "#A0522D",
  "Epsilonbacteraeota" = "#AEDF12",
  "Synergistetes" = "#D2B48C",
  "Euryarchaeota" = "#FFE2FD"
  )

# Prevalence + phylum come ONLY from the OR (logistic) df, per spec.
anno_phyla      <- microbe_ORs_shared$Phylum      # categorical
anno_prevalence <- microbe_ORs_shared$prevalence  # continuous

cont_colors <- colorRamp2(c(min(anno_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
                            median(anno_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
                            max(anno_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE)),
                          c("lightgrey", "dimgrey", "black"))

or_col_fun   <- colorRamp2(c(0.5, 1, 3), c("#008080", "#F7F7F7", "#800000"))
beta_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#313695FF", "white", "#A50026FF"))
```

## Combined circos plot

```{r combined.circos}
#pdf("../figures/circos_shared_OR_CLR.pdf", width = 9.5, height = 7)
circos.clear(); circos.par(RESET = TRUE)
circos.par(start.degree = 90, gap.degree = 10, cell.padding = c(0,0,0,0))

## ---- Ring 1 (outermost): logistic regression odds ratios ----
circos.heatmap(OR_matrix, col = or_col_fun, na.col = "darkgrey",
               cluster = FALSE,
               rownames.side = "outside", rownames.cex = 0.4,
               track.height = 0.1, bg.border = "black", bg.lwd = 0.4)
or_track <- get.current.track.index()

# Significance stars for the OR track (uses OR q-values)
n_col_OR <- ncol(OR_matrix)
circos.track(track.index = or_track, bg.border = NA, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  ind <- CELL_META$subset[CELL_META$row_order]
  for (j in seq_len(n_col_OR)) {
    lab <- vapply(ind, function(i) stars(qval_mat_OR[i, j]), character(1))
    circos.text(seq_along(ind) - 0.5, rep(j - 0.5, length(ind)), lab,
                cex = 0.3, col = "black",
                facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE)
  }
})

## ---- Ring 2: CLR beta coefficients ----
circos.heatmap(beta_matrix, col = beta_col_fun, na.col = "darkgrey",
               cluster = FALSE,
               track.height = 0.1, bg.border = "black", bg.lwd = 0.4)
beta_track <- get.current.track.index()

# Significance stars for the CLR track (uses CLR q-values)
n_col_beta <- ncol(beta_matrix)
circos.track(track.index = beta_track, bg.border = NA, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  ind <- CELL_META$subset[CELL_META$row_order]
  for (j in seq_len(n_col_beta)) {
    lab <- vapply(ind, function(i) stars(qval_mat_beta[i, j]), character(1))
    circos.text(seq_along(ind) - 0.5, rep(j - 0.5, length(ind)), lab,
                cex = 0.3, col = "black",
                facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE)
  }
})

## ---- Ring 3: Prevalence (from OR df) ----
prev_mat <- matrix(microbe_ORs_shared$prevalence, ncol = 1,
                   dimnames = list(shared_taxa, "Prevalence"))
circos.heatmap(prev_mat, col = cont_colors, cluster = FALSE,
               track.height = 0.03, bg.border = "black", bg.lwd = 0.1)

## ---- Ring 4 (innermost): Phylum (from OR df) ----
phy_mat <- matrix(microbe_ORs_shared$Phylum, ncol = 1,
                  dimnames = list(shared_taxa, "Phylum"))
circos.heatmap(phy_mat, col = phyla_colors, cluster = FALSE,
               track.height = 0.03, bg.border = "black", bg.lwd = 0.1)

## ---- Legends ----
lgd_or <- Legend(title = "Odds Ratio", col_fun = or_col_fun,
                 title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
                 legend_height = unit(2, "cm"),
                 grid_width    = unit(3, "mm"),
                 title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
                 labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))

lgd_beta <- Legend(title = "Beta Coefficient", col_fun = beta_col_fun,
                   title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
                   legend_height = unit(2, "cm"),
                   grid_width    = unit(3, "mm"),
                   title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
                   labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))

lgd_prev <- Legend(title = "Prevalence", col_fun = cont_colors,
                   title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
                   legend_height = unit(2, "cm"), grid_width = unit(3, "mm"),
                   title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
                   labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))

lgd_phy <- Legend(title = "Phylum", legend_gp = gpar(fill = phyla_colors),
                  labels = names(phyla_colors), title_position = "topleft",
                  grid_height = unit(3, "mm"),
                  grid_width  = unit(3, "mm"),
                  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
                  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))

draw(packLegend(lgd_or, lgd_beta, lgd_prev, lgd_phy, gap = unit(4, "mm")),
     x = unit(0.88, "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"), just = "left")
circos.clear()
#dev.off()
```
